text: For #948: the page shows an issue as the factory's when a label or a line of its text hands it over, as before, and also an open one once a writer's /invariant solve or plan comment hands it over, or once the factory has posted on it or runs a step on it, so it shows with what the factory is doing before the factory posts, and the activity shows the command. A closed one the factory ratified a build on counts as merged, finished by hand, when a merged pull request whose text says it closes the issue, in GitHub's closing words, merged as the issue closed, within five minutes, into the factory's branch. Refining D-0440, the orbit, the tiles, the fleet and who builds what count it, and say it was finished by hand. A pull request a person opened for an issue the factory never took counts in none of them. A refresh reads at most ten such closed issues' comments, so a dashboard with nothing kept spreads those reads over its refreshes.
